# NestNook

> NestNook is a blog for US renters and small homes about renter-friendly smart homes: 108 no-drill, deposit-safe guides for apartments and small homes — lighting, security, climate, kitchen and budget setups under $100.

## Guides

- Smart home for renters and small homes
- No-drill video doorbells and security
- Renter-friendly smart lighting
- Climate, kitchen and budget smart-home setups under $100

## Site

- Homepage: https://nestnook.pages.dev/
